That night he kept the beam burning an hour longer than usual, sweeping it slowly across the dark water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡的街道上投下昏黄的光，红绿灯仍在无人的路口按时变换。远处传来环卫工人扫帚划过地面的沙沙声，早点铺的蒸笼刚刚冒出第一缕白气。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，只有零星几盏亮着，像是还未入睡的心事。风从河面吹来，带着微凉的潮气，让人清醒。出租车偶尔驶过，尾灯划出一道红线，转眼便消失在街角。天边还没有一丝亮色，可空气里已经有了黎明将至的味道。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a nesting doll to find a smaller doll inside.\n- Each copy keeps passing the job down to a smaller one until it reaches the tiniest case, which is so easy it can be answered right away.\n- Then the answers come back up one by one, like climbing out of the dolls, until the biggest job is finished."}
